result.title: Food Critic: An Agentic Visualization System for Auditable Restaurant-Safety Reasoning
result.summary: Generative AI agents are increasingly being embedded into visualization systems that can search data, invoke tools, summarize evidence, and produce recommendations. However, when agents rely solely on their own knowledge, the visualization problem is not only whether the agent provides a useful answer, but also whether users can inspect how that answer is grounded. We present Food Critic, an agentic visualization system for diners' restaurant decision support that integrates public health inspection records with crowd review data. The system grounds agents under three conditions: a database-only ReAct agent, a retrieval- augmented agent with access to food-safety regulations, and an ontology-guided agent that produces structured hypotheses and typed evidence. Food Critic externalizes the agent's reasoning within these groundings as inspectable visual evidence. We evaluate LLM models with several use cases under each grounding of our agentic system. Our work positions restaurant choice as a concrete case for studying human-agent collaboration, visual provenance of agent reasoning, and the design of visual interfaces for grounded GenAI decision support.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Food Critic，一个面向餐厅安全决策的 agentic 可视化系统，整合卫生检查记录与大众点评数据，对比三种 grounding：仅数据库的 ReAct 代理、可检索食品安全法规的 RAG 代理、以及产出结构化假设与类型化证据的本体引导代理，并把推理过程外化为可查验的视觉证据。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「结构化假设＋类型化证据＋可审计溯源」的设定可能与 LVR 中的证据筛选、推理状态可读性与贡献归属问题相通，可供核查；但系统不含 latent 状态或视觉多模态推理机制，迁移价值需较多确认。
